title: Move the top crate
prompt: Take the top crate off pile a with pop_back and put it on top of pile b with append. Return pile b.
hints: pop_back gives you the crate; append puts it down.

docs.name: list.pop_back()
docs.what: Removes the last item and returns it.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.
